review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit of the database optimization and the compatibility status of the naming change are not independently verified by the provided observations; the score relies on the implementation and test presence rather than measured performance or compatibility results.

observations.behavior: Adds select_related to ExternalDataSchema query and uses schema.table.name if available, otherwise falls back to build_table_name.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces database round-trips when resolving warehouse table names by eagerly loading related source and table metadata; could improve query performance and prevent N+1 issues in warehouse ingestion pipelines.

observations.behavior: Adds parametrized test cases for HogQL table name generation, including cases with linked table and None, and checks dot-notation output.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression tests for warehouse table name construction, including edge cases where the linked table is missing; could help prevent regressions in warehouse ingestion and HogQL compatibility.
